specs: bracelet width in the render (24 official)
notes: Built from Bulova's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference).

Modelled: gold case and lugs, black polygon ring, gold bezel with six black screws, applied gold Roman numerals and logo, subdial and open-heart rings, gold sword hands with lume and open windows, small seconds hand, fluted crown, five-column bracelet with the house curl.
From the photo map: black sunray dial, chapter ring with minute numerals, BULOVA / Marine Star / 200m / Automatic 21 Jewels, subdial print and the open heart's movement.
The minute hand covers part of II in the render; it is completed from its mirror image. Heights are read from the official side view.
